title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility
authors_zh: Xiaoyuan Liu, Jianhong Tu, Yuqi Chen, Siyuan Xie, Sihan Ren, Tianneng Shi, Gal Gantar, Evan Sandoval, Donghyun Lee, Daniel Miao, Peter J. Gilbert, Nick Hynes, Mauro Staver, Warren He, David Marn, Andrew Low, Xi Zhang, Elron Bandel, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Siva Reddy, Alexandre Drouin, Alexandre Lacoste, Ramayya Krishnan, Elham Tabassi, Yu Su, Victor Barres, Chenguang Wang, Wenbo Guo, Dawn Song
paper_type_zh: 智能体评测协议、基础设施与案例研究
best_for_zh: 研究 agent evaluation、环境反馈契约、episode 审计与 replay 边界的读者
one_line: AgentBeats turns a benchmark into an A2A/MCP judge agent that owns tasks, environments and scoring, and validates the interface through a 298-judge/467-subject field study plus standardized coding-agent episodes.
AgentBeats 将 benchmark 封装为掌管任务、环境与评分的 A2A/MCP judge agent，以统一评测 episode 的协议边界；但 arXiv v2 未绑定可重放轨迹、结果与实现清单。
why: It exposes the missing contract around agent trajectories—who provides the environment, what the judge can observe, how terminal outcomes become metrics, and which deployment artifacts must be pinned—while also showing why protocol standardization alone does not make traces licensed or exactly replayable.
inclusion_reason: AgentBeats makes the evaluation environment and feedback contract first-class agents: a judge packages tasks, tools, environment setup and scoring behind A2A/MCP, producing complete subject-agent episodes whose results can be compared and audited even though the paper does not release a reusable trajectory corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative record for this Card is arXiv:2606.13608v2, revised on 2026-06-14, and the accepted venue is arXiv preprint. AgentBeats documentation also links an ICML poster titled Position: Agent Evaluation Should Be Agentified for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility. Because that title differs from the assigned paper and no official identity mapping was verified, this Card does not treat ICML as the venue of the arXiv record.

Agent assessment is usually packaged as benchmark-specific code: task retrieval, environment startup, tool exposure, subject-agent interaction, stopping, scoring, and result formatting are coupled to one harness. That makes it difficult to connect independently developed agents and judges or to compare what their scores mean. AgentBeats addresses this interface problem through Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA): the benchmark becomes a judge agent, the evaluated system becomes a subject agent, and a delegator binds their endpoints and configuration using A2A for task messaging and MCP for tools.

The relevant data object is an assessment episode, not a standalone prompt or answer. Its protocol envelope contains the assessment request, participant roles/endpoints, configuration, judge-issued task, optional A2A/MCP events, tool or environment observations, subject response and output artifact, final environment state, judge metrics, score, and a JSON result report whose inner schema remains assessment-specific. A judge can use fixed or adaptive tasks and can score with programmatic tests, environment predicates, semantic prompts/LLM judgment, or a mixture.

This episode-and-feedback boundary places the work in environment_agent_trajectory_data, even though the paper does not release a centralized trajectory dataset. The evidence reaches Card depth for the protocol, roles, deployment modes, field study, coding case, feedback contract, and audit risks. The accepted curation_level nevertheless remains L3_summary_ready: exact arXiv-v2 implementation commits, images, configurations, record-level traces/results, replay manifests, rights, decontamination, and retention policy are still unknown.

本卡片的权威记录是 2026 年 6 月 14 日修订的 arXiv:2606.13608v2，accepted venue 为 arXiv preprint。AgentBeats 文档还链接了一篇题为 Position: Agent Evaluation Should Be Agentified for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility 的 ICML poster。由于该标题与本卡片论文不同，且没有核验到官方身份映射，本卡片不把 ICML 写成该 arXiv 记录的 venue。

传统 agent assessment 往往封装在 benchmark 专用代码中：任务获取、环境启动、工具暴露、subject-agent 交互、停止、评分与结果格式相互耦合。这样既难连接独立开发的 agent 与 judge，也难比较不同 score 的含义。AgentBeats 用 Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA) 处理这一接口问题：benchmark 被封装为 judge agent，被测系统是 subject agent，delegator 通过 endpoint 与 configuration 绑定双方，并分别用 A2A 传递任务消息、用 MCP 暴露工具。

本工作对应的数据对象是一条 assessment episode，而不是孤立的 prompt 或 answer。它的协议外层包含 assessment request、参与方 role/endpoint、configuration、judge 下发的 task、可选 A2A/MCP event、tool 或 environment observation、subject response 与 output artifact、final environment state、judge metric、score，以及内部 schema 随 assessment 变化的 JSON result report。judge 可以使用固定或自适应任务，也可以通过程序化 test、environment predicate、语义 prompt/LLM judgment 或混合方式评分。

尽管论文没有发布集中式 trajectory dataset，这种 episode 与 feedback 边界仍使其属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data。现有证据足以深入描述 protocol、角色、部署模式、field study、coding case、feedback contract 与审计风险；但 accepted curation_level 仍保持 L3_summary_ready：与 arXiv v2 绑定的实现 commit、image、configuration、逐条 trace/result、replay manifest、权利、去污染与 retention policy 仍为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: AgentBeats turns assessment logic into a judge agent that owns tasks, tools, environments, stopping, metrics, and result reporting behind A2A/MCP, so independently hosted subject agents can produce comparable protocol-level evaluation episodes without sharing one internal harness.

Three roles define the mechanism. A delegator selects participants and sends the kick-off request plus role-to-endpoint mapping and configuration. The judge retrieves or generates tasks, prepares data, environment, and tools, issues A2A instructions, receives subject messages or completion updates, observes exposed MCP/environment effects, and produces predefined metrics and a result report. One or more subject agents attempt the task through their own A2A responses and any MCP capabilities exposed by the judge. Agent construction, registration, and execution are distinct lifecycle stages; local, remote, hosted, proxy, and CI modes place those stages on different infrastructure.

The feedback contract is intentionally heterogeneous. Programmatic tests and environment predicates can inspect executable artifacts or final state; semantic judges can inspect responses through prompts or LLM scoring; a judge can combine both. In the coding case, completion or timeout ends interaction, then benchmark evaluation scripts score collected artifacts and environment state. This feedback observes only what the judge exposes and records. It does not prove that predicates are complete, that an LLM judge is calibrated, that remote logs/reset behavior are sufficient, or that scores from different judges share a common reward meaning. A “judge agent” is therefore not synonymous with “LLM-as-judge.”

Relative to a conventional benchmark wrapper, AAA moves assessment ownership behind a standard agent interface rather than requiring every subject to adopt benchmark-specific orchestration. Relative to an executable environment benchmark such as tau2-bench, AgentBeats standardizes the outer participant and transport contract across heterogeneous assessments rather than publishing one fixed task/episode schema. The resulting object is useful for interface and feedback audit, but protocol standardization alone does not create a licensed trajectory corpus or exact replay package.

For reasoning-data research, the key chain is: delegator configuration -> judge task/data/environment -> subject A2A/MCP episode -> response/artifact/final state -> judge metric/result. Full-episode and state/action-level fields describe observable evaluation surfaces. The paper uses them for evaluation and comparative audit only; its discussion of possible RL integration is not evidence of agent_training or rlvr.

一句话贡献是：AgentBeats 把 task、tool、environment、stopping、metric 与 result reporting 封装进 A2A/MCP 背后的 judge agent，使独立托管的 subject agent 无需共享同一内部 harness，也能生成协议层可比较的 evaluation episode。

该机制由三种角色定义。delegator 选择参与方，发送 kick-off request、role-to-endpoint mapping 与 configuration。judge 获取或生成任务，准备 data、environment 与 tool，通过 A2A 下发 instruction，接收 subject message 或 completion update，观察被暴露的 MCP/environment effect，最后输出预定义 metric 与 result report。一个或多个 subject agent 通过自身的 A2A response 和 judge 暴露的 MCP capability 完成任务。agent construction、registration 与 execution 是不同 lifecycle stage；local、remote、hosted、proxy 与 CI mode 把这些阶段放在不同基础设施上。

feedback contract 有意允许异构实现。程序化 test 与 environment predicate 可以检查可执行 artifact 或 final state；semantic judge 可以通过 prompt 或 LLM scoring 检查 response；同一 judge 也可以混合两者。在 coding case 中，completion 或 timeout 结束交互，随后 benchmark evaluation script 对收集的 artifact 与 environment state 评分。反馈只能观察 judge 暴露并记录的内容，不能证明 predicate 完整、LLM judge 已校准、remote log/reset 足以复现，也不能证明不同 judge 的 score 共享同一种 reward 含义。因此，“judge agent”不等于“LLM-as-judge”。

相较传统 benchmark wrapper，AAA 把 assessment ownership 放到标准 agent interface 后面，而不再要求每个 subject 适配 benchmark 专用 orchestration。相较 tau2-bench 这类可执行 environment benchmark，AgentBeats 标准化的是跨异构 assessment 的外层参与方与 transport contract，而不是发布一个固定的 task/episode schema。该对象适合接口与反馈审计，但协议标准化本身不会产生已有明确许可的 trajectory corpus 或准确 replay package。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，关键链路是：delegator configuration -> judge task/data/environment -> subject A2A/MCP episode -> response/artifact/final state -> judge metric/result。full-episode 与 state/action-level 字段描述可观察的 evaluation surface。论文只将其用于 evaluation 与 comparative audit；文中讨论的潜在 RL integration 不是 agent_training 或 rlvr 的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and authoring. A judge agent owns benchmark data or task generation, environment setup, tool servers, evaluation flow, metrics, scoring, and reporting. Subject agents expose A2A endpoints and use judge-provided MCP tools where required; a delegator supplies participant roles/endpoints and configuration. Community participants authored judges and subjects for the field study. Repositories that were inaccessible or malformed were excluded and the rest deduplicated, but the frozen inventory, exclusion ledger, deduplication keys, and prompt-extraction implementation were not released.

Construction, registration, and deployment. Agent blueprints can be represented by Git repositories or Docker images and deployed as A2A endpoints. The platform separates construction from registration and assessment execution. Five modes are described: local, remote, hosted, proxy, and CI. They vary in where agents run, who initiates the assessment, and whether results appear in platform records, logs, or committed artifacts. The current leaderboard template uses scenario/component manifests, GitHub Actions, result directories, Docker images, secrets, sharding, and Amber, but it is a rolling artifact rather than the immutable stack for arXiv v2.

Episode execution. The delegator initiates the assessment. The judge loads fixed data or generates/adapts tasks, prepares the environment and MCP tools, and sends A2A task instructions or access information. The subject responds, calls tools, changes the environment, and signals completion; the judge may continue or stop according to its own policy. The output envelope consists of messages/updates, tool calls and observations where observable, subject response or artifact, final state, metrics, score, and a JSON report. No universal action vocabulary or inner result schema is imposed.

Verifier, reward, and termination. Each judge defines its own metrics using programmatic checks, environment predicates, semantic prompts/LLM judgment, or a mixture. Termination is assessment-specific. In the coding case, the judge starts an isolated source-tree container, injects the subject runtime or provides remote shell over MCP, waits for completion or timeout, collects artifacts, and runs the benchmark's evaluation scripts. This produces a terminal solve score rather than dense token-level supervision. Runtime injection has a preflight and remote-shell fallback because injection can fail or perturb the container.

Coding-case selection and settings. The case study uses 731 SWE-Bench Pro public instances, all 89 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1,222 DevEval instances retained after executing ground-truth tests and dropping failures. Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B are paired respectively with Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and mini-SWE-agent. Defaults are used; reported thinking effort is xHigh, Medium, High, and enabled without another level, respectively. Main experiment cost is about USD 6,000. Temperatures, seeds, per-instance rollout counts, retries, exact time limits, and full configurations remain unknown.

Outputs and use boundary. Appendix A aggregates tool/resource statistics across successful and failed coding runs, but no record-level trajectory/log/result archive or exclusion ledger tied to v2 is released. The earlier agentbeats/agentbeats SDK's latest release is v1.2.6 from 2025-11-17; its README marks it deprecated, and it predates the June 2026 paper. Exact reproduction must therefore pin paper version, repositories/commits, images, benchmark snapshots, model/API behavior, prompts, secrets/configuration, timeouts, result schema, and retained outputs. The demonstrated use is evaluation and audit, not model training.

输入与 authoring。 judge agent 掌管 benchmark data 或 task generation、environment setup、tool server、evaluation flow、metric、scoring 与 reporting。subject agent 暴露 A2A endpoint，并在需要时使用 judge 提供的 MCP tool；delegator 提供参与方 role/endpoint 与 configuration。field study 中的 judge 和 subject 由社区参与者编写。研究排除了不可访问或 malformed 的 repository，并对其余仓库去重，但没有发布冻结 inventory、exclusion ledger、deduplication key 与 prompt-extraction 实现。

构造、注册与部署。 agent blueprint 可以由 Git repository 或 Docker image 表示，再部署成 A2A endpoint。平台把 construction、registration 与 assessment execution 分开。论文描述 local、remote、hosted、proxy 与 CI 五种 mode，它们在 agent 运行位置、assessment 发起方以及 result 出现在平台记录、log 还是提交 artifact 上存在差异。当前 leaderboard template 使用 scenario/component manifest、GitHub Actions、result directory、Docker image、secret、sharding 与 Amber，但它是滚动更新的 artifact，而不是 arXiv v2 的不可变实验 stack。

Episode 执行。 delegator 发起 assessment。judge 加载固定 data 或生成/自适应 task，准备 environment 与 MCP tool，并通过 A2A 发送 task instruction 或访问方式。subject 作出 response、调用 tool、改变 environment 并报告 completion；judge 按自身 policy 继续或停止。输出外层由可观察的 message/update、tool call 与 observation、subject response 或 artifact、final state、metric、score 和 JSON report 组成。系统不强制统一 action vocabulary 或内部 result schema。

Verifier、reward 与 termination。 每个 judge 通过程序化 check、environment predicate、语义 prompt/LLM judgment 或混合方式定义 metric；termination 也由 assessment 决定。在 coding case 中，judge 启动隔离的 source-tree container，注入 subject runtime 或通过 MCP 提供 remote shell，等待 completion 或 timeout，收集 artifact，再运行 benchmark evaluation script。该过程生成 terminal solve score，而不是 token 级 dense supervision。由于 runtime injection 可能失败或扰动 container，流程包含 preflight 与 remote-shell fallback。

Coding case 的选择与设置。 case study 使用 SWE-Bench Pro public split 的 731 个 instance、Terminal-Bench 2.0 全部 89 个 task，以及执行 ground-truth test 并丢弃失败项后保留的 1,222 个 DevEval instance。Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 分别与 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、mini-SWE-agent 配对。各 agent 使用 default setting；reported thinking effort 依次为 xHigh、Medium、High，以及仅开启 thinking 而未给出进一步 level。主实验成本约 6,000 美元。temperature、seed、逐 instance rollout 数、retry、准确 time limit 与完整 configuration 仍为 unknown。

输出与用途边界。 Appendix A 汇总成功与失败 coding run 的 tool/resource statistics，但没有发布与 v2 绑定的逐条 trajectory/log/result archive 或 exclusion ledger。早期 agentbeats/agentbeats SDK 的最新 release 是 2025 年 11 月 17 日的 v1.2.6；README 已将其标记为 deprecated，而且该版本早于 2026 年 6 月论文。准确复现因此必须固定 paper version、repository/commit、image、benchmark snapshot、model/API behavior、prompt、secret/configuration、timeout、result schema 与保留输出。论文实际展示的用途是 evaluation 与 audit，不是模型训练。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The field study reports 298 judge agents in 12 categories and 467 subject agents from independent participants over five elapsed months (paper §7, Figure 5). The official competition page dates Phase 1 from 2025-10-16 to 2026-01-31 and Phase 2 from 2026-03-02 to 2026-06-02. The paper describes a planned six-month competition still in progress at writing, so these counts are a platform snapshot rather than a frozen dataset release.

Repository analysis provides construction evidence but not a public inclusion manifest. After inaccessible or malformed submissions were excluded and the remainder deduplicated, Python appeared in 99% of judge-agent repositories and 98% of subject-agent repositories. Prompts were detected in 78.3% of judge repositories; prompt-bearing judges averaged 241 prompt lines and 11.6k characters (paper §7, Table 4). The exact repository list, exclusion ledger, deduplication keys, and prompt-scanner snapshot were not published, so those statistics cannot be independently rebuilt from an immutable paper artifact.

The coding case supplies an executable feedback example. It evaluates four model-harness pairings on 731 SWE-Bench Pro public instances, 89 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1,222 DevEval tasks retained after ground-truth-test validation. The main experiment cost is reported as about USD 6,000 (paper §8.3). In the harness-swap experiment, native pairings win five of six comparisons with an average 5.3-percentage-point solve-rate advantage; Terminal-Bench 2.0 contains a time-budget exception (paper §8.5, Table 7). These are author-reported configuration comparisons, not independent reproduction.

Trajectory inspection also exposes a negative signal. For DevEval, Gemini 3.1 Pro with OpenCode has a reported tool-call error rate of about 2%; Appendix Table 10 gives 2.44%, more than ten times the other agents. The authors attribute its cost anomaly to inefficient exploration and harness incompatibility. Harness logs are not fully comparable, however: tool sets differ, mini-SWE-agent omits token counts, and a shell call can hide read/edit/search behavior (Appendix A). The causal reading is therefore an author interpretation from non-uniform traces.

Public-score fidelity is explicitly limited. The study does not reproduce Anthropic's SWE-Bench Pro memorization screen, cannot use Qwen's unreleased corrected benchmark form, and uses Terminal-Bench thinking-effort settings that differ from public vendor reports (§8.4). Appendix A includes aggregate statistics for both succeeded and failed runs, but no record-level trajectory, artifact, score, or failure archive tied to arXiv v2 was verified. The evidence supports the protocol and reported evaluation findings; it does not establish trajectory completeness, verifier calibration, licensing, exact replay, or training-data quality.

field study 报告了来自独立参与者的 298 个 judge agent、12 个 category 与 467 个 subject agent，覆盖已进行的五个月（论文 §7、Figure 5）。官方 competition page 将 Phase 1 标为 2025 年 10 月 16 日至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，将 Phase 2 标为 2026 年 3 月 2 日至 6 月 2 日。论文称计划中的六个月 competition 在写作时仍在进行，因此这些数量是平台 snapshot，而不是冻结的 dataset release。

repository analysis 提供了构造证据，但没有公开 inclusion manifest。排除不可访问或 malformed 的提交并对其余仓库去重后，Python 出现在 99% 的 judge-agent repository 与 98% 的 subject-agent repository 中；78.3% 的 judge repository 检测到 prompt，含 prompt 的 judge 平均有 241 行 prompt、1.16 万字符（论文 §7、Table 4）。由于准确 repository list、exclusion ledger、deduplication key 与 prompt-scanner snapshot 均未发布，这些统计无法从不可变论文 artifact 中独立重建。

coding case 提供了一条可执行 feedback 示例。研究在 SWE-Bench Pro public 的 731 个 instance、Terminal-Bench 2.0 的 89 个 task，以及通过 ground-truth-test validation 后保留的 1,222 个 DevEval task 上评测四组 model-harness pairing。主实验成本报告为约 6,000 美元（论文 §8.3）。在 harness-swap 实验中，native pairing 在六项比较中的五项获胜，solve-rate 平均优势为 5.3 个百分点；Terminal-Bench 2.0 存在一个与 time budget 有关的例外（论文 §8.5、Table 7）。这些是作者报告的 configuration comparison，并非独立复现。

trajectory inspection 还暴露了负面信号。在 DevEval 上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 OpenCode 组合报告了约 2% 的 tool-call error rate；Appendix Table 10 的准确值为 2.44%，超过其他 agent 的十倍。作者把成本异常归因于低效 exploration 与 harness incompatibility。但 harness log 并不完全可比：tool set 不同，mini-SWE-agent 不提供 token count，而一次 shell call 可能隐藏 read/edit/search 行为（Appendix A）。因此，该因果解释是作者基于非统一 trace 作出的判断。

论文明确限制了 public-score fidelity。研究没有复现 Anthropic 的 SWE-Bench Pro memorization screen，无法使用 Qwen 未发布的 corrected benchmark form，并且 Terminal-Bench 的 thinking-effort setting 与公开 vendor report 不同（§8.4）。Appendix A 同时汇总成功与失败 run 的 aggregate statistics，但没有核验到与 arXiv v2 绑定的逐条 trajectory、artifact、score 或 failure archive。现有证据支持 protocol 与报告的 evaluation finding，却不能证明 trajectory 完整、verifier 已校准、许可充分、可准确 replay 或具备 training-data quality。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The baseline is benchmark-specific orchestration: an evaluator owns hidden assumptions about data loading, environment setup, tool invocation, subject integration, stopping, scoring, and report shape. AgentBeats changes the unit of integration by “agentifying” that evaluator. A judge agent exposes task management through A2A and tool/environment access through MCP, while a delegator connects independently developed judge and subject endpoints.

The resulting evaluation object has a reusable outer contract: participant mapping and configuration, judge-issued task, subject interaction, environment effects, terminal response/artifact/state, metric, and result report. The inner action space and result JSON remain judge-specific. This is a protocol and infrastructure contribution, not a claim that all benchmarks now share one data schema or one calibrated reward.

The field study adds empirical scope to the interface: 298 judge agents in 12 categories and 467 subject agents were registered across a live competition snapshot. The coding case then shows how one judge can own isolated containers, expose runtime injection or MCP remote shell, retain artifacts, run benchmark tests, and compare model-harness pairings. Together, these connect interface design to observable episode and terminal-feedback behavior, while the missing frozen inventory and run archive constrain auditability.

AgentBeats does not newly invent A2A, MCP, programmatic benchmark tests, LLM judges, containers, CI evaluation, or agent registries. It composes those components around a judge-agent abstraction and separates construction, registration, and execution across five deployment modes. Claims of openness, standardization, or reproducibility must therefore be evaluated at the artifact level: a common transport does not make tasks open, semantic judges calibrated, remote services resettable, or outputs licensed.

For the assigned track, the direction signal is making the environment and feedback owner explicit in the episode schema. Reuse should verify what each judge observes, how termination differs from success, which metric or predicate produces the score, which failures are retained, and which versions are pinned. No exact v2-bound trajectory/log/result/replay manifest is released, and the old SDK is deprecated, so the contribution is currently stronger as an evaluation-design and audit reference than as a reusable data release.

prior-work baseline 是 benchmark-specific orchestration：evaluator 在 data loading、environment setup、tool invocation、subject integration、stopping、scoring 与 report shape 中隐含了一组专用假设。AgentBeats 通过把 evaluator “agentify” 改变集成单元。judge agent 用 A2A 暴露 task management、用 MCP 暴露 tool/environment access，delegator 则连接独立开发的 judge 与 subject endpoint。

由此形成的 evaluation object 具有可复用外层 contract：参与方 mapping 与 configuration、judge 下发的 task、subject interaction、environment effect、terminal response/artifact/state、metric 与 result report。内部 action space 与 result JSON 仍由具体 judge 决定。因此这是 protocol 与 infrastructure 贡献，而不是所有 benchmark 已共享单一 data schema 或已校准 reward 的主张。

field study 为接口提供了经验范围：在 live competition snapshot 中登记了 12 个 category 的 298 个 judge agent 和 467 个 subject agent。coding case 进一步展示 judge 如何掌管隔离 container、提供 runtime injection 或 MCP remote shell、保留 artifact、运行 benchmark test，并比较 model-harness pairing。这两部分把接口设计连接到可观察的 episode 与 terminal-feedback behavior；同时，缺少冻结 inventory 与 run archive 仍限制审计。

AgentBeats 并没有分别发明 A2A、MCP、程序化 benchmark test、LLM judge、container、CI evaluation 或 agent registry。它围绕 judge-agent abstraction 组合这些组件，并在五种 deployment mode 中拆分 construction、registration 与 execution。因此，对 openness、standardization 或 reproducibility 的判断必须落到 artifact 层：通用 transport 不会自动使 task 开放、semantic judge 得到校准、remote service 可 reset 或输出拥有明确许可。

对指定 track 而言，方向价值在于使 episode schema 中的 environment 与 feedback owner 明确可见。复用前应核验每个 judge 能观察什么、termination 与 success 如何区分、哪种 metric 或 predicate 产生 score、哪些 failure 被保留、哪些 version 已固定。当前没有发布与 v2 准确绑定的 trajectory/log/result/replay manifest，旧 SDK 也已弃用，因此该贡献目前更适合作为 evaluation-design 与 audit reference，而不是可复用 data release。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Identity and version boundary: the accepted paper is arXiv:2606.13608v2 from 2026-06-14. The differently titled ICML Position Paper is not verified as the venue version of this record. The earlier official SDK ends at v1.2.6 from 2025-11-17, is marked deprecated, and predates the paper; current tutorial, template, gateway/Amber stack, documentation, and dashboard evolve independently.
  • No v2 replay bundle: no immutable commit/image manifest, benchmark snapshot, full configuration, prompt, model/API version, timeout, result bundle, or record-level replay archive was verified for Tables 6–10. CI and local execution recipes show that configured assessments can run, not that historical results can be exactly reconstructed.
  • No released trajectory corpus: Appendix A aggregates successful and failed runs, but no paper-linked archive exposes per-instance messages, tool logs, artifacts, scores, retries, exclusions, and failure reasons. A universal result schema is absent; current tutorial results may be free-form JSON. Full-episode and state/action descriptors therefore identify possible fields, not a standardized dataset release.
  • Judge heterogeneity: programmatic tests, environment predicates, semantic prompts, and LLM judges do not share one error model or reward meaning. Predicates can omit requirements or accept shortcuts; semantic scoring can exhibit rubric bias, false positives/negatives, or prompt injection. The paper recommends isolating semantic scoring in a sub-agent but does not adversarially audit or calibrate all 298 judges.
  • Environment and observability risk: remote agents may lack complete logs or standardized reset behavior. Runtime injection can fail or perturb coding containers, requiring preflight and remote-shell fallback. Authentication/control-plane support protects access but does not prove deterministic state, reliable replay, or complete observation.
  • Model, harness, and metric drift: several models and production harnesses are proprietary. APIs, defaults, reasoning effort, tools, and provider behavior can change. Harness logs are structurally unequal, mini-SWE-agent omits token counts, and shell calls can conceal multiple semantic actions, limiting cross-harness trace comparison.
  • Benchmark exposure and fidelity: there is no platform-wide contamination audit or universal split. The study does not reproduce Anthropic's SWE-Bench Pro memorization screen and cannot use Qwen's unreleased corrected benchmark form. Public tasks and differing reasoning-effort settings make vendor-score matching and future exposure claims configuration-dependent.
  • Selection and retention unknowns: the frozen 298-judge/467-subject inventory, repository exclusion ledger, deduplication keys, prompt-scanner snapshot, per-instance rollout counts, seeds, retries, and failure policy are undisclosed. Aggregate inclusion of failures does not establish that every failed run was retained.
  • Licensing and privacy: the manuscript is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, but checked core/reference repositories expose no verified common license and no umbrella grant for benchmark tasks, submitted agents, trajectories, logs, or results. Remote/hosted modes may process credentials, private services, code, and execution traces; consent, retention, deletion, and redistribution policy is incomplete.
  • Use boundary: the paper evaluates and audits agents; it does not train a policy, reward model, process model, or RL agent on AgentBeats episodes. Proposed RL integration cannot justify training reuse. Benchmark performance does not establish data quality, judge validity, or generalization across assessment categories.

• 身份与版本边界： accepted paper 是 2026 年 6 月 14 日的 arXiv:2606.13608v2。不同标题的 ICML Position Paper 没有被核验为本记录的 venue version。早期官方 SDK 最后停在 2025 年 11 月 17 日的 v1.2.6，已标记 deprecated，且早于论文；当前 tutorial、template、gateway/Amber stack、documentation 与 dashboard 均独立演化。
  • 没有 v2 replay bundle： 没有核验到与 Tables 6–10 绑定的不可变 commit/image manifest、benchmark snapshot、完整 configuration、prompt、model/API version、timeout、result bundle 或逐条 replay archive。CI 与 local execution recipe 只说明配置后的 assessment 可以运行，不能证明历史结果可准确重建。
  • 没有发布 trajectory corpus： Appendix A 汇总成功和失败 run，却没有论文绑定的 archive 暴露逐 instance message、tool log、artifact、score、retry、exclusion 与 failure reason。系统也缺少 universal result schema；当前 tutorial result 可以是 free-form JSON。因此 full-episode 与 state/action descriptor 表示潜在字段，而不是标准化 dataset release。
  • Judge 异构性： 程序化 test、environment predicate、semantic prompt 与 LLM judge 不共享同一种 error model 或 reward 含义。predicate 可能遗漏要求或接受 shortcut；semantic scoring 可能有 rubric bias、false positive/negative 或 prompt injection。论文建议把 semantic scoring 隔离在 sub-agent 中，但没有对全部 298 个 judge 做对抗审计或校准。
  • Environment 与 observability 风险： remote agent 可能缺少完整 log 或标准 reset behavior。runtime injection 可能失败或扰动 coding container，因此需要 preflight 与 remote-shell fallback。authentication/control-plane support 能保护访问，但不能证明 state 确定、可可靠 replay 或 observation 完整。
  • Model、harness 与 metric 漂移： 多个 model 与 production harness 是 proprietary。API、default、reasoning effort、tool 与 provider behavior 可能变化。harness log 的结构不等价，mini-SWE-agent 不提供 token count，而 shell call 可隐藏多个语义 action，限制跨 harness trace comparison。
  • Benchmark exposure 与 fidelity： 平台没有统一 contamination audit 或 universal split。研究没有复现 Anthropic 的 SWE-Bench Pro memorization screen，也无法使用 Qwen 未发布的 corrected benchmark form。公开 task 与不同 reasoning-effort setting 使 vendor-score matching 和未来 exposure 判断依赖具体 configuration。
  • Selection 与 retention 未知： 冻结的 298-judge/467-subject inventory、repository exclusion ledger、deduplication key、prompt-scanner snapshot、逐 instance rollout 数、seed、retry 与 failure policy 均未披露。aggregate analysis 包含 failure 并不能证明每条失败 run 都被保留。
  • 许可与隐私： manuscript 采用 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0，但已检查的核心/reference repository 没有核验到统一 license，也没有覆盖 benchmark task、submitted agent、trajectory、log 或 result 的 umbrella grant。remote/hosted mode 可能处理 credential、private service、code 与 execution trace；consent、retention、deletion 与 redistribution policy 不完整。
  • 用途边界： 论文进行 agent evaluation 与 audit，没有用 AgentBeats episode 训练 policy、reward model、process model 或 RL agent。潜在 RL integration 不能支持 training reuse。benchmark performance 也不能证明 data quality、judge validity 或跨 assessment category 的泛化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, AgentBeats is best used as an evaluation-interface and audit reference. It provides a checklist for serializing an assessment episode: participant roles/endpoints, configuration, task id/instruction, environment access, A2A messages, MCP calls and observations, subject response/artifact, final environment state, metric, score, termination, and result report. Applying that checklist to another agent benchmark makes missing state, action, observation, verifier, and replay fields visible.

The judge-agent abstraction is useful for feedback-contract audits. Researchers can classify each judge's observable surface and scoring path as programmatic, environmental, semantic, or mixed; distinguish completion/timeout from success; test predicate shortcuts and semantic-judge injection; and record whether resets, logs, artifacts, failure reasons, and metric components survive execution. Cross-judge results should retain judge identity and metric semantics rather than being collapsed into one generic reward.

The five deployment modes support infrastructure comparison when versions are pinned. A study can run the same judge-subject pairing locally, remotely, through hosted/proxy control, and in CI, then compare authentication failures, environment initialization, observable logs, artifact retention, reset behavior, latency, and score agreement. Such a study needs fixed endpoints, commits, images, secrets policy, result schema, timeout/retry settings, and benchmark snapshots; the paper does not supply a complete v2 manifest.

The coding case is a template for configuration-aware audit rather than a source of certified trajectories. Researchers can reconstruct a matrix over benchmark task, model, harness, reasoning effort, injection versus MCP remote shell, completion/timeout, evaluation script, and terminal score, then examine harness incompatibility and tool-log measurement bias. Appendix A's success/failure aggregates motivate retention checks, but a new study must publish record-level outputs because the paper does not.

Safe reuse level is evaluation and audit only. Do not use AgentBeats as evidence for SFT demonstrations, preference pairs, process supervision, reward-model data, RLVR, or agent-training rollouts. Training reuse and exact replay are blocked until arXiv v2 is bound to immutable code/images/configs/results/traces, split and contamination controls, retention/privacy policy, and explicit rights for tasks, submitted agents, logs, trajectories, and leaderboard outputs.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，AgentBeats 最适合作为 evaluation interface 与 audit reference。它提供了一份 assessment episode 序列化清单：参与方 role/endpoint、configuration、task id/instruction、environment access、A2A message、MCP call 与 observation、subject response/artifact、final environment state、metric、score、termination 和 result report。用该清单检查其他 agent benchmark，可以暴露缺失的 state、action、observation、verifier 与 replay 字段。

judge-agent abstraction 适合 feedback-contract audit。研究者可以把每个 judge 的 observable surface 与 scoring path 分类为 programmatic、environmental、semantic 或 mixed；区分 completion/timeout 与 success；测试 predicate shortcut 和 semantic-judge injection；并记录 reset、log、artifact、failure reason 与 metric component 是否在执行后保留。跨 judge 结果应保留 judge identity 与 metric semantics，而不能压缩成一个泛化 reward。

五种 deployment mode 可用于固定版本后的 infrastructure comparison。研究可以在 local、remote、hosted/proxy control 与 CI 中运行相同 judge-subject pairing，再比较 authentication failure、environment initialization、observable log、artifact retention、reset behavior、latency 与 score agreement。此类研究必须固定 endpoint、commit、image、secret policy、result schema、timeout/retry setting 与 benchmark snapshot；论文没有提供完整 v2 manifest。

coding case 是 configuration-aware audit 的模板，而不是已认证 trajectory 的来源。研究者可以围绕 benchmark task、model、harness、reasoning effort、injection 与 MCP remote shell、completion/timeout、evaluation script 和 terminal score 重建矩阵，再检查 harness incompatibility 与 tool-log measurement bias。Appendix A 的 success/failure aggregate 提示应审计 retention，但新研究必须发布逐条输出，因为论文没有提供。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。不得把 AgentBeats 当作 SFT demonstration、preference pair、process supervision、reward-model data、RLVR 或 agent-training rollout 的证据。只有在 arXiv v2 与不可变 code/image/config/result/trace、split 与 contamination control、retention/privacy policy，以及覆盖 task、submitted agent、log、trajectory 和 leaderboard output 的明确权利绑定后，training reuse 与准确 replay 的阻断条件才可能解除。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Anchor every claim to arXiv:2606.13608v2 (2026-06-14). The differently titled ICML Position Paper is related official material, not a verified venue record for this title.
  • Keep the object concrete: delegator request and role/endpoint configuration -> judge task/data/environment -> A2A/MCP interaction -> response/artifact/final state -> metric, score, and assessment-specific JSON report.
  • Read the 298-judge/467-subject field-study snapshot separately from the coding case over 731 SWE-Bench Pro, 89 Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 1,222 filtered DevEval tasks; neither is a released trajectory corpus.
  • Reproduction must reconcile the deprecated v1.2.6 SDK with the later paper and rolling tutorial/template/dashboard stack, then pin commits, images, benchmark snapshots, model/API settings, timeouts, outputs, and failure retention.
  • Reuse is evaluation/audit only: the manuscript is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, repository and umbrella trace/result licensing is unclear, and benchmark scores do not certify data quality.

• 所有结论都应锚定 arXiv:2606.13608v2（2026 年 6 月 14 日）。不同标题的 ICML Position Paper 是相关官方材料，不是该标题已核验的 venue record。
  • 数据对象必须具体：delegator request 与 role/endpoint configuration -> judge task/data/environment -> A2A/MCP interaction -> response/artifact/final state -> metric、score 与 assessment-specific JSON report。
  • 应把 298-judge/467-subject 的 field-study snapshot 与 coding case 分开阅读；后者使用 731 个 SWE-Bench Pro、89 个 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 1,222 个过滤后的 DevEval task，两者都不是已发布 trajectory corpus。
  • 复现必须调和 deprecated v1.2.6 SDK、较晚发布的论文与滚动更新的 tutorial/template/dashboard stack，并固定 commit、image、benchmark snapshot、model/API setting、timeout、output 与 failure retention。
  • 复用仅限 evaluation/audit：manuscript 是 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0，repository 与统一 trace/result 许可不清楚，benchmark score 也不能认证 data quality。

items: Judge semantics are heterogeneous: programmatic tests, environment predicates, prompts and LLM judges are not interchangeable, so scores across judges do not share one reward meaning.
Semantic judge or user-simulation logic can be prompt-injected; the paper recommends isolating scoring in a sub-agent but does not audit all 298 judges for attacks or false positives.
Remote agents may lack observable logs and standardized reset behavior; authentication and control-plane support are necessary but not a proof of reproducibility.
Coding-agent runtime injection can fail or perturb the evaluation container, motivating a preflight and remote-shell fallback.
Several evaluated models and production harnesses are proprietary, and provider/API/model behavior may drift after the paper.
Public-score fidelity depends on configuration and benchmark version: memorization screens, corrected splits and reasoning-effort choices differ from vendor reports.
Harness-level tool logs are not fully comparable: each harness exposes different tools, MSA omits token counts, and shell calls can hide read/edit/search actions.
No paper-linked task/trajectory data card, immutable container/image manifest, result bundle or record-level replay archive was verified.
The earlier official SDK is deprecated and predates arXiv v2, while the current tutorial, gateway/template stack and live dashboard continue to change.
Core/reference repository licenses and an umbrella task/trace/result license are missing, blocking confident redistribution or training-data reuse.
评审语义是异构的：程序化测试、环境谓词、提示与 LLM 评审模型不可互换，因此跨评审的分数不共享同一奖励含义。
语义评审或用户模拟逻辑可能被提示注入；论文建议在子智能体中隔离评分，但未对全部 298 个评审就攻击或假阳性进行审计。
远程智能体可能缺少可观察日志与标准化重置行为；认证与控制平面支持是必要的，但不是可复现性的证明。
代码智能体运行时注入可能失败或扰动评测容器，因而需要预检与远程 shell 回退。
若干被评测模型与生产评测脚手架为专有，提供方/API/模型行为可能在论文之后漂移。
公开分数保真度取决于配置与基准版本：记忆筛查、校正划分与 reasoning-effort 选择与厂商报告不同。
评测脚手架级工具日志不完全可比：每个评测脚手架暴露不同工具，MSA 省略 token 计数，且 shell 调用可隐藏 read/edit/search 动作。
未核验到与论文链接的任务/轨迹数据卡、不可变容器/镜像清单、结果包或记录级回放档案。
早期官方 SDK 已 deprecated 且早于 arXiv v2，而当前教程、gateway/template 栈与实时 dashboard 仍在变化。
核心/参考仓库许可与总括任务/trace/结果许可缺失，阻碍有把握的再分发或训练数据复用。

value.html: Competition and remote/hosted modes can involve private services, credentials and execution logs. The checked paper and official artifacts do not provide a complete consent, retention, deletion or redistribution policy for submitted code and traces.

value.html: Delegator request/config -> judge data/environment/tool setup -> subject-agent episode -> judge scoring -> local/platform/CI result. The paper does not publish a record-level lineage manifest tying field-study or coding-case records to immutable artifact versions.
